text: APPROVE. The prerequisite loop moves verbatim into `AppendPrerequisites`, so the `break` and `TryGetValue` logic behave the same, and nothing followed the loop in the original method. Moving the nested `foreach`, `if`, `break` and `if` out removes enough cognitive complexity to bring the method under 15. I judged build safety from the diff alone: the parameters appear to match what `AppendRule` already receives, with the possible risk being the exact type of `rules` or `variables`.
